pairs.subject: data-access
pairs.evidence: src/lib/db/mentor-share.ts:37 A stored mentor share that fails validation returns the same absence value as a missing record, concealing corruption from the Developer home.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/db/org-rollup.ts:182 The loader uses getRepoStates once and associates its keyed results with the developer's repositories, avoiding per-repository fetches.
src/lib/org/developer-view-load.ts:11 The application loader calls named repository operations; the route and client components do not construct database queries.
src/lib/db/agent-sessions-viewer.ts:39 The personal session read supplies organization, identity keys, and time bounds through typed Prisma predicates rather than interpolated query text.
src/lib/org/developer-view.ts:115 The display projection exposes writable properties and mutable arrays, falling short of the technique's explicit requirement that projections be read-only by type.

src/lib/org/developer-view-load.test.ts:16 These application-loader tests mock the repository interface, the boundary explicitly permitted by the technique; this does not certify underlying repository integration tests.
src/lib/db/mentor-share.ts:37 A present but invalid record becomes null without a distinguishable decode failure; malformed JSON also returns null.

pairs.subject: data-access
pairs.evidence: src/lib/github/governance.ts:71 A successful branch response containing an object without a valid protected boolean becomes a confident protection verdict instead of a distinguishable decoding failure.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/github/graphql.ts:162 Reviews arrive inside the paginated PR query, avoiding a separate review request per PR; page size and total page count are bounded.
src/lib/scan-ingest.ts:180 The consumer checks the optional enrichment function before dispatch; EnrichmentSource uses optional function members, and GitHub binds its implementation explicitly.

src/lib/github/source.ts:29 The ingestion layer imports a helper from the application scoring-prompt module, reversing the required dependency direction and coupling data access to prompt construction.
src/lib/github/graphql.ts:97 The static GraphQL query carries owner, repository, pagination size, and cursor separately as variables.
src/lib/github/governance.ts:71 The preceding guard accepts any non-null object: {} maps to false and a string such as "false" maps to true, without validating the field's boolean shape.

src/lib/github/graphql.ts:152 The supplied production modules perform API reads and pure transformations; their GraphQL POST executes a query, and no multi-write unit of work was found in these files.

pairs.registryProposal: Clarify repo-testing for hosted HTTP data providers: specify when recorded or mocked response tests require supplementary live contract checks, and what evidence can substitute when the provider cannot run locally.
